scope: Remove all-date option from normal period menu; unify Task labels; Drawer context menu with drag reorder/membership; excluded import management and archived list restore entry; independent all-date default for trash
final_change_coverage: The final 85-test run includes natural drop targets, same-scope trash reentry reset, persistence, excluded-item and archived-list entry points. Earlier screenshot runs overlap these tests and are not additional unique cases.

analysis.capture_method: Exact stdout copied from successful direct flutter analyze --no-pub exec

legacy_period_all: Old persisted normal period all decodes to today. HomePeriod.all remains available for the transient trash period only.
settings_management: Settings entry removed. Existing internal management State and edit/create handlers remain reused; they were not replaced with new CRUD logic.
natural_drop_behavior: No temporary rows; existing list/tag upper/lower half chooses before/after with a paint-only insertion line. Existing Lists heading or Inbox accepts moves to root; folder header accepts moves into the folder.
